svg.title: Autoscaling with prefix affinity starves new pods
svg.desc: Two side-by-side animations of KEDA scaling an llm-d deployment from 2 to 8 pods on A100. With the prefix-affinity filter, every request keeps going to the 2 original pods (about 6,475 requests each, 256 running) and the 6 new pods serve 0 requests. With a load-only router the new pods serve 908 to 1,242 requests each, and burst TTFT p99 after all pods are Ready drops from 1,197 ms to 164 ms.
svg.text: KEDA scales 2 to 8 pods: prefix affinity starves the new pods, load-aware routing uses them
Aggregated, not P/D: A100x8, up to 8 TP1 pods, llm-d keda-epp guide, KEDA 2.20.2. Only the router profile varies; one run per arm.
Burst client, after all 8 pods Ready
Burst client, after all 8 pods Ready
Scale decisions: 2 to 4 pods 6 s after the burst started, 4 to 8 pods at 21 s. New pods Ready about 3 min after container start (model load + torch.compile).

g.text: Phase: burst on the 2 original pods
Phase: KEDA adds 6 pods, they load the model (dashed = not Ready)
Phase: all 8 pods Ready. Left: still 2 pods serve. Right: traffic spreads to all 8.

svg.text: Time compressed; dot counts illustrative. HPA scale-up stabilization set to 0 s for the test (guide default 300 s).
